To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the orthorhombicity of the BIMGVO X solid solution is maintained to high values of Mg doping and that phase separation occurs in this system at high temperature.
an orthorhomic phase is stabilized at high Mg contents in the BIMEVOXE solid solution.
the BIMEVO X system is not limited to tetragonal γ-BIMEVOX and that the system exhibits phase separation at high temperatures.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the structural and electrical behaviour in the system Bi 2 MgxV1 − xO 5.5 − 3x/2 − δ at the composition Bi 2 MgV 0.5 O 5.5, which lies close to the composition limit in the pseudo binary system Bi 2 VO 4 –BiMgO 3.5, and the effect of the substitution of V 5 + by Mg 2 + in this phase.
the synthesis and characterisation of a novel BIMEVOX material.
the synthesis, structure and electrical behaviour of the BIMEVOS phase Bi 2 V 0.5 Mg 0.5 O 5.5.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bi 2 Mg x V 1 − x O 5.5 − δ phase field extends to at least x =0.3 and possibly higher values of x.
the orthorhombicity is a function of the vanadium content and is not related to the MgO layer.
the orthorhombicity of the BIMEVX phase is due to the presence of Mg 2+ cations in the structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the orthorhombicity in the BIMGVOXE system increases with the increase in V 4+ content, which is consistent with the structural data for the BIMEVOXE system.
the BIMEVOXA solid solution is not limited to a tetragonal phase, and that the orthorhombicity of the BIMEVXA phase is not a function of the composition of the system.
the BIMEVOXA system has been shown to be a very complex system, with a number of phases, which exhibit phase separation on heating.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the BIMEVOXA phase in the BIMGVOXA system is not a simple solid solution of Bi 2 MgVO 5.5 and Bi 2 V 2 O 8, but is rather more complex and exhibits phase separation and structural change with temperature.
a new orthorhombicity is observed at high x in the BIMEVOXE system and that this orthorhombity is not due to the formation of an additional phase.
the BIMEVOVX phase can exist as an orthorhomic polymorph in a narrow compositional range.
